extensions.name: statement description
extensions.value: The European Medicines Agency (EMA) has authorized trastuzumab in combination with capecitabine or 5-fluorouracil and cisplatin for the treatment of adult patients with HER2 positive metastatic adenocracinoma of the stomach or gastroesophageal junction who have not received prior anti-cancer treatment for their metastatic disease. The production information for trastuzumab in this indication further specifies that trastuzumab should only be used in patients with metastatic gastric cancer whose tumors have HER2 overexpressed as defined by IHC 2+ and a confirmatory SISH or FISH result, or by an IHC 3+ result, as measured by an accurate and validated assay.
